parts.title: pause, refusals, the owner's approval while paused, resume

groups.attempted: An approval queued before the pause; the owner pauses the agent
While paused: an agent operation and a keyed buyer's early-pay acceptance
groups.expected: both refused; nothing on the chain for them; REVOKED security events; nothing agreed

groups.attempted: While paused: the owner approves the approval queued before the pause
groups.expected: EXECUTED (by design: the owner's own decision re-runs the gates but not the pause check)

groups.attempted: Resume: the same buyer message is agreed again

steps.title: reset the demo books (golden_sme)
